name: Notification Center
description: A personal inbox of notifications that each user can read, filter, mark as read and clear
backend_requirements: Access control: require auth for every notification endpoint, and each signed-in user sees and changes only their own notifications; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

POST /api/notifications adds a notification to the signed-in user's own inbox; message is a required non-empty string of at most 500 characters and type one of info, warning or error (default info); new notifications are unread

GET /api/notifications lists the signed-in user's active notifications, newest first; ?read=true or ?read=false filters by read state, ?type= by type, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100); total counts every matching notification and unread_count all of the user's unread ones regardless of the filters
PATCH /api/notifications/:id sets read to true or false
POST /api/notifications/read-all marks every unread notification of the signed-in user as read and returns how many changed
Deactivated notifications (is_active false) are left out of the owner's list and counts and answer 404 on the item endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Visitors see a short description of the notification center and a 'Sign in to see your notifications' prompt; everything else is for signed-in users
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
A header badge with the unread count that stays in step with the list

Notification list: an icon and colour per type, the message and a relative time ('5 minutes ago'), unread notifications highlighted, tabs for All, Unread and Read, a type filter and previous/next paging
Per notification: a 'Mark as read' / 'Mark as unread' toggle and a delete button; above the list a 'Mark all as read' button
A small 'New notification' form (message and type) for adding one to your own inbox, showing the API's validation messages next to the form
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every notification of every user, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts and the number of unread ones
Toggle a notification's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: The signed-in user's active notifications, newest first, filtered and paged

query.read: true for read notifications only, false for unread only
query.type: Only notifications of this type (info, warning or error)
